evidence.section: Integrator Filter Principle; Bounce Filter Availability

details.semantics: A short pulse is remembered and delivered during the next scan; falling-edge latch is unavailable.
Rising edge requests RUN; low level forces STOP. Input cannot simultaneously serve FC/HSC/latch/event or other function block. Hardware Run/Stop switch also exists.
details.input16_caveat: HW p69 row I16 shows Run/Stop unavailable despite general prose saying all inputs: unresolved table inconsistency; reject or require validation for %I0.16 assignment.

evidence.section: Controller state transitions; Digital input properties

details.overload: Short-circuit protection and automatic retry each1s; group enters protection together.

details.restriction: Cannot also be used as program output; fallback field disabled.

capabilities.title: Output default values, maintain values and expert-function stop behavior

details.regular_outputs: Configured0/1 fallback or Maintain values according to fallback mode.
details.expert_outputs: PTO fallback forced0; expert outputs HSC/PLS/PWM/PTO/FREQGEN listed0 in general table.
details.forcing: Output forcing overrides application logic; persists logout/online change, cleared by cold start/download; forcing does not apply to expert functions.
details.HSC_conflict: HSC-specific p175 says reflex outputs0 if Maintain values is selected, otherwise configured fallback; general p37 says all expert outputs0.

details.semantics: IN enables counting/hold; R initializes0 for up or preset for down, resets D. D latches when up reaches preset or down reaches0.

details.conflicts: An auxiliary pin allocated to HSC cannot simultaneously be FC/event; HSC0 dual phase consumes HSC2 pulse pin, HSC1 dual phase consumes HSC3 pulse pin.

capabilities.title: Two mutually exclusive pulse generator resources

details.sharing: Each output can implement one allocated expert function. A PTO direction output may consume another output including the other fast pulse pin; CW/CCW PTO0 consumes both fast outputs and disables PTO1.

details.update_semantics: Period change at end of ongoing period. P0/out-of-range stops. Pulse count change applies next execution; out-of-range count forced0.

capabilities.title: Two PWM outputs with integer-percent duty cycle

details.semantics: R is duty%; >100 treated100; period changed at end of active period; P0 stops output; IN0 drives output0.

details.sync: Rising SYNC applies target frequency immediately without waiting end of active period.
details.stop: Application stop cancels generation without waiting pulse end; ERROR remainsFALSE. Errors auto-acknowledge when condition clears.

capabilities.title: Up to4 local TM2/TM3/TM3R expansion modules

details.ordering: TM2 cannot precede any TM3/TM3R module
details.caveat: Exact optional-module reference, channel count, range, bus consumption and max digital outputs require its own official module manual and official-editor hardware validation. Family support does not imply every TM3 accessory/safety/expert module is supported.

capabilities.title: Active/passive expansion error management and restart

details.active_default: %S106=0; after2 consecutive unsuccessful bus-task cycles, TM3 outputs0; bus off.
details.passive: %S106=1; TM3 holds~10s then0 if unrecovered; TM2 holds indefinitely until power cycle/initialize; embedded I/O/application continue.
details.restart: Rising%S107 only if%S106=0,%SW118 bit14=0,and at least one%SW120 bit=1.

evidence.section: I/O Bus Error Handling; system words

capabilities.title: Two TMCR2 cartridge slots and compatibility rules

details.older_levels: OneTMCR2SL1 orTMCR2SL1A maximum; oneI/O+one serial or two I/O supported.
details.functional_level12_1: TMCR2SL1S supported. Allowed2serial combinations:TMCR2SL1A+TMCR2SL1S, or2xTMCR2SL1S. TwoTMCR2SL1A or twoTMCR2SL1 not allowed.
details.level12_0: Exact12.0 boundary not clarified: prose says<12.0 legacy and>=12.1 new; treat12.0 conservatively as legacy.

details.filter_config: Filter0..100 times100ms unit (0..10s); hardwarep31 says0.01s increment, conflict.

details.purpose: Enable/disable the remote drive power stage
requirements: Configured Modbus TCP IOScanner or Modbus Serial IOScanner
Supported ATV drive type added to scanner with predefined initialization and channels
details.exchange: Modbus FC23 (0x17) reads/writes drive ETA, ETI, RFRD, DP0 and CMD registers as configured.
details.STOP_HALT: Fallback values sends command0x00 leading to Switch On Disabled/NST; Maintain values leaves command unchanged. Empty/powerless/application update stops scanning.
details.boundary: This is a remote Altivar drive over Modbus; do not map it to the embedded pulse generator resource or assume an external ATV is present.
